P.name: Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard
P.title: Template:Data Kled & Skaarl/Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Kled
|disp_name    = Skaarl, the Cowardly Lizard
|skill        = I
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Kled}} rides his semi-trusty steed, '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''', whom takes damage for him while he is {{sbc|Mounted}}. When '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' health depletes, '''Kled''' dismounts, {{tip|cleanse|cleansing}} from all {{tip|crowd control}}.
|blurb2      = '''Kled''' remains {{sbc|Dismounted}} until he returns to the [[Spawn|summoning platform]], but can restore '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' {{as|Courage|buzzword}} by fighting enemies. At maximum {{as|Courage|buzzword}}, '''Kled''' becomes {{sbc|Mounted}} with a portion of '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' health.
|blurb4      = {{sbc|Dismounted:}} '''Kled''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while moving toward enemy champions, but his basic attacks deal less damage to champions. ''{{ai|Bear Trap on a Rope|Kled}}'' is replaced with ''{{ai|Pocket Pistol|Kled}}'', and '''Kled''' cannot cast his other abilities.
|icon         = Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard.png
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Kled''' rides his semi-trusty mount, '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}'''. While {{sbc|Mounted}}, all damage dealt to the duo is suffered by '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''', who has {{pplevel|color=health|{{#expr:{{ccd|Kled & Skaarl|hp_base}}-{{ccd|Kled|hp_base}}}}+{{#expr:{{ccd|Kled & Skaarl|hp_lvl}}-{{ccd|Kled|hp_lvl}}}}*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))|formula={{#expr:{{ccd|Kled & Skaarl|hp_base}}-{{ccd|Kled|hp_base}}}}+{{#expr:({{ccd|Kled & Skaarl|hp_lvl}}-{{ccd|Kled|hp_lvl}})*17 round 1}}/17*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))}} {{as|'''base''' health}}; additional sources of health are applied to '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' {{as|'''maximum''' health}}. Effects based on percentage health consider '''Kled''' and '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' combined {{as|'''maximum''' health}}.
|icon2        = Kled Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard 2.png
|description2 = Being reduced below {{as|{{sti|health|0 health}}}} causes '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' to flee, forcing '''Kled''' to be {{sbc|Dismounted}}, with all damage in excess of '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' health being ignored. Upon dismounting, '''Kled''' {{tip|lunge|lunges}} in the direction of the allied [[Nexus]], though {{tt|not through terrain|see notes}}, while {{tip|cleanse|cleansing}} himself of all {{tip|crowd control}} and becoming {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}, {{tip|untargetable}}, and {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. {{ai|Dismounted Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard|Kled|''Dismounting''}} resets the {{sti|cooldown}} and charges of ''{{ai|Pocket Pistol|Kled}}''.
|description3 = While '''Kled''' is {{sbc|Dismounted}}, his {{as|'''base''' health}} and {{as|movement speed}} are reduced; however, he gains {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} while moving toward enemy champions. Additionally, he gains {{sti|attack range|'''bonus''' attack range}}, and his attacks deal {{pp|85 to 100 for 4|1;6;11;16|key=%}} damage to champions. ''{{ai|Bear Trap on a Rope|Kled}}'' is replaced with ''{{ai|Pocket Pistol|Kled}}'', while ''{{ai|Jousting|Kled}}'' and ''{{ai|Chaaaaaaaarge!!!|Kled}}'' become unusable.
|description4 = While {{sbc|Mounted}}, {{tip|heal|healing}} and {{as|{{sti|health regeneration}}}} will first replenish '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' health and will only apply to '''Kled's''' health while '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' is at ''full'' health.
|description5 = ''For more details, check the {{sbc|Dismounted}} part of the ability.''
|leveling     = 
|customlabel  = lunge range
|custominfo   = 200
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|speed        = 400
|damagetype   = 
|spellshield  = 
|spelleffects = 
|projectile   = 
|notes        = 
* '''Kled''' and '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' [[health bar]] is split in two segments, representing each of them respectively.
** While {{sbc|Mounted}}, '''Kled's''' health is visually rounded up while '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' health is rounded down.
** While {{sbc|Dismounted}}, '''Kled's''' health is visually rounded down while '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' health is rounded up.
* Excess damage dealt to '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' counts for the purposes of effects based on damage dealt (eg. {{iis|Death's Dance}} {{nie|Ignore Pain}}, {{iis|Stormsurge}} {{nie|Stormraider}}, item damage trackers).{{bug|2}}
* The dismount threshold does not interact with the threshold of {{nie|Lifeline}} effects, meaning both can be triggered from the same damage instance even if triggering one should prevent triggering the other.{{bug}}
** If '''Kled''' dismounts and triggers a {{nie|Lifeline}} {{tip|shield}} effect from the same damage instance, excess damage dealt to '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' will be dealt to the shield when it exceeds the lifeline threshold.{{bug|2}}[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0t_wu84JXQQ]
* If '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' health is reduced below 0 by an attack or ability with multiple damage instances, subsequent damage instances from the same {{tip|cast instance}} are reduced to 0 damage.
* {{iis|The Collector}} {{nie|Death}} is special cased to not affect '''Kled''' while he is {{sbc|Mounted}}, regardless of the duo's combined {{as|'''current''' health}}. 
* If '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' health is reduced below 0 by {{iis|Eclipse}} {{nie|Ever Rising Moon}}, '''Kled''' will take the triggering attack's damage.{{bug|2}}
* While {{tip|untargetable}}, '''Kled''' rapidly {{tip|homing projectile destruction|destroys}} enemy projectiles targeting him.
* Kled's {{tip|gameplay radius}} does not change when becoming {{sbc|Mounted}} or {{sbc|Dismounted}}, even though his model size changes visually.
* '''Kled''' does not receive damage from {{cai|Test of Spirit|Illaoi}}, {{cai|Umbral Trespass|Kayn}}, or being {{ai|Regurgitate|Tahm Kench|Regurgitated}} by {{ci|Tahm Kench}} while dismounting.{{bug}}
<!--is that because these are projectiles? old yuntal also didn't do damage-->
* The {{tip|lunge}} can pass through [[Terrain#Player-Generated|player-generated terrain]].{{bug|2}}
* Buying [[items]] while '''Kled''' and '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' combined {{as|'''current''' health}} is lower than '''Kled's''' {{as|'''maximum''' health}} will cause '''Kled''' to dismount upon [[shop#Undo|undoing]] the purchase and potentially lose {{as|health}}.{{bug}}
* {{pending for test}} Dismounting with a {{tip|spell shield}} sometimes consumes the spell shield and negates the effects of dismounting.{{bug}}<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cV4RRurNEr0 Edge of Night bug]</ref>
* If '''Kled''' would be {{tip|execute|executed}} while {{sbc|Mounted}}, he is instead only {{sbc|Dismounted}}.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Kled''' is lunging:
{{ct|attack=false|move=false|cast=false|items=true,,,false|consume=true|spells=true,false,false,false,false,false,false|interrupts=death}}
}}

Q.name: Bear Trap on a Rope
Q.title: Template:Data Kled & Skaarl/Bear Trap on a Rope
Q.wikitext:
<!-- The following values are defined as parameters
-->{{#vardefine:mq_b1|30}}<!-- First hit Rank 1 base damage
-->{{#vardefine:mq_b5|130}}<!--First hit Rank 5 base damage
-->{{#vardefine:mq_ad|60}}<!-- First hit bonus AD ratio
-->{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Bear Trap on a Rope|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Kled
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Bear Trap on a Rope.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Kled}} throws a bear trap in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and forms a {{tip|tether}} against the first {{tip|champion}} or {{tip|monster|large monster}} hit, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them.
|blurb2      = The tether shrinks over a brief time, after which '''Kled''' {{tip|airborne|pulls}} the target, dealing {{as|physical damage}}, and briefly {{tip|slow|slowing}} them.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kled''' throws a bear trap in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased to 150% against {{tip|minion|minions}}, small {{tip|pet|pets}}, and small and medium {{tip|monsters}}. The bear trap collides with the first enemy {{tip|champion}}, large pet, or large monster hit, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, and forming a {{tip|tether}} between '''Kled''' and the target for {{fd|1.75}} seconds.
|leveling     = {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|{{#var:mq_b1}} to {{#var:mq_b5}}}} {{as|(+ {{#var:mq_ad}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Minion and Small Monster Damage|{{ap|{{#var:mq_b1}}*1.5 to {{#var:mq_b5}}*1.5}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:{{#var:mq_ad}}*1.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|description2 = The tether's radius shrinks over its duration, and if it is not broken before then, '''Kled''' {{tip|airborne|pulls}} the target {{tt|150|Estimated}} units toward him, deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.
|leveling2    = {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|{{#var:mq_b1}}*2 to {{#var:mq_b5}}*2}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:{{#var:mq_ad}}*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|{{#var:mq_b1}}*3 to {{#var:mq_b5}}*3}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:{{#var:mq_ad}}*3}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|30 to 50}}%}}
|description3 = ''Bear Trap on a Rope can be cast while {{ai|Jousting|Kled}}.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|11 to 7}}
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|range        = {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 800|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|60|Center-to-edge radius check for enemies within the projectile's origin point, prioritizing the closest unit that can be affected by the tether.}}}}
|width        = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 90
|speed        = 1600
|targeting    = Direction
|tether radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{pp|round=ceil|type=time active|800 to 625 for 8|0 to 1.75}}
|affects      = Enemies
|spellshield  = True
|projectile   = True
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|notes        = 
{{Effect at cast time end}}
** The visual effect of ''Bear Trap on a Rope'' will appear at '''Kled's''' height at the end of cast time and may not portray its {{tip|projectile}} accurately if '''Kled''' is ''{{ai|Dismounted Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard|Kled|dismounting}}'' at the end of cast time.
*** {{pending for test}} Is the same true if '''Kled''' is {{tip|airborne}}?
* The ability will cast to wherever the caster's cursor was at the start of the cast time.
* In addition to its {{tip|projectile}}, ''Bear Trap on a Rope'' will check for enemy champions, large monsters and large pets within a 60-unit center-to-edge radius area from the projectile's origin point.
** The projectile interacts with projectile-blocking effects but the area check doesn't.
* {{ui|link=Annie#Summon:_Tibbers|Tibbers}}, {{ai|Daisy!|Ivern|Daisy}} and {{ai|Eulogy of the Isles|Yorick|The Maiden}} are considered {{tip|pet|large pets}} for this ability.
** All other pets are considered small pets for the purposes of this ability.
* ''Bear Trap on a Rope'' will not {{tip|airborne|pull}} the target if they are in {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}}.
** {{pft}} certain sources of stasis are not affected 
* The tether cannot be broken within the first {{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|estimated}} seconds of its application.
* {{cai|Void Rush|Rek'Sai}} will break the tether upon the beginning of its cast time.{{bug}}
* The pull damage is updated dynamically based on '''Kled's''' current attack damage.
* {{csl|Kled|Count Kledula}} has no sound cue for when the tether is broken.{{bug}}
* The damage is also increased to 150% against {{ci|Neeko}} disguised as a {{tip|ward}}.
|tips        =
* When ''{{ai|Dismounted Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard|Kled|dismounting}}'' while attempting to cast ''Bear Trap on a Rope'', players should input movement commands to avoid unintentionally buffering {{ai|Pocket Pistol|Kled}}.

W.name: Violent Tendencies
W.title: Template:Data Kled & Skaarl/Violent Tendencies
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Violent Tendencies|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Kled |skill = W |icon = false |icon2 = Violent Tendencies.png |blurb = {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Kled}} periodically gains ''Violent Tendencies'', which starts expiring upon his next basic attack. |blurb4 = {{sbc|Violent Tendencies:}} '''Kled''' gains {{sti|attack speed|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for his next 4 basic attacks within a few seconds. The final attack deals {{as|'''additional''' physical damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}. |description = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Kled''' periodically gains ''Violent Tendencies'', which starts expiring upon his next {{tip|basic attack}}. |description2 = {{sbc|Violent Tendencies:}} '''Kled''' gains {{sti|attack speed|{{as|150% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} on his next 4 basic attacks within 4 seconds. The fourth attack is empowered to deal {{as|'''additional''' physical damage}}. The damage based on the target's health is capped at 200 against {{tip|monsters}}.

''Violent Tendencies' '' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|0.5}} seconds {{tip|on-hit}}, increased to {{fd|1.5}} against champions. |leveling2 = {{st|Additional Physical Damage|{{ap|20 to 60}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4.5 to 6.5}}% {{as|(+ 2% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.4}}% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}} |description3 = Against {{tip|structures}}, the fourth attack deals modified {{as|'''additional''' physical damage}}. |leveling3 = {{st|Structure Additional Damage|{{pplevel|62+1.75*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))|formula=62 + 1.75 * (level - 1) * (0.7025 + 0.0175 * (level - 1)) (aka growth formula)}} (+ {{ap|0 to 60}})}} |cooldown = {{tt|{{ap|13 to 9}}|Starts after the attacks time out or are consumed}} |cdstart = post-effect |targeting = Passive |affects = Enemies |spellshield = False |projectile = |grounded = |knockdown = |parry = True |notes = * ''Violent Tendencies''' '''additional''' damage is applied as a separate damage instance from the attack that triggers it. ** This causes {{iis|Black Cleaver}} {{nie|Carve}} to be applied twice.{{bug|2}} ** This damage instance is applied before the damage of the attack. *** ''Violent Tendencies''' attack will proc {{tip|on-hit}} effects even if the '''additional''' damage kills the target. * Attacking a [[jungle plants|plant]] or {{tip|ward}} will not activate ''Violent Tendencies''. ** Attacking either while ''Violent Tendencies'' is already active will still consume an attack. * '''Kled''' gains {{as|attack speed}} even on non-''Violent Tendencies'' attacks as long as the ability is not on cooldown. * While affected by {{tip|Silence}} or {{tip|Forced Action|Forced Actions}}, the animations and sounds of '''Kled's''' first 3 ''Violent Tendencies'' attacks are replaced with default ones.{{bug}} ** The first and third attack will instead play {{tip|critical strike}} animations if they strike critically. * Learning ''Violent Tendencies'' will cancel '''Kled's''' ongoing {{tip|attack windup}}.{{bug|2}} ** In contrast, ''Violent Tendencies'' coming off cooldown during an ongoing attack windup will not cancel it. *** Successfully finishing the basic attack will then cause ''Violent Tendencies'' to begin expiring, but will not count as one of the 4 attacks. |tips = * Players should consider when they want to learn ''Violent Tendencies'' to avoid "wasting" its cooldown. |damage = true |damagedetails= {{Infobox damage |dtitle = Kled - Violent Tendencies: Additional Damage |dtype = p |dbasic = true |dability = true |dApplyDamageModifier = |dApplyLifesteal = true |dApplyOmnivamp = true |dEnableCallForHelp = true |dEnableKill = |dRespectDodge = true |dRespectImmunity = |dTriggerDamageEvents = |dTriggerOnHitEvents = false |dnotes = * Can {{tip|blind|miss}} and be {{tip|dodge|dodged}} and {{tip|block|blocked}}. }} |yvideo = sOYwYR1WTp8 }}

E.name: Jousting
E.title: Template:Data Kled & Skaarl/Jousting
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Jousting|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Kled
|skill        = E
|icon         = Jousting.png
|icon3        = Jousting 2.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies she passes through and marking enemy {{tip|champions}} hit. The mark {{tip|true sight|reveals}} the target for a short time, during which ''Jousting'' can be recast.
|blurb2      = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' consumes the mark to {{tip|dash}} through the marked target.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, though not through terrain, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies she passes through and {{tip|airborne|pulling}} {{tip|minion|minions}}, {{tip|pet|pets}}, and small and medium {{tip|monster|monsters}} hit towards her.
|leveling     = {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|35 to 135}} {{as|(+ 55% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|description2 = Upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} or large monster, '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' {{tip|dashes}} a fixed 350 units through them, marking them for 3 seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}. After the dash ends, the duo gain {{sti|ms|{{as|50% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 1 second. ''Jousting'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the first dash ending while the target is marked.
|description3 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' consumes the mark to {{tip|dash}} through the marked target, applying the same effects as the first cast though being able to dash through terrain.
|leveling3    = {{st|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|35*2 to 135*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|description4 = The mark will remain even if the target dies, and ends prematurely if the duo are too far away or '''Kled''' ''{{ai|Dismounted Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard|Kled|dismounts}}''.
|description5 = ''{{ai|Bear Trap on a Rope|Kled}} and {{ai|Chaaaaaaaarge!!!|Kled}} can be cast during either of the dashes.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|13 to 9}}
|cdstart      = Starts after the first dash ends, see notes
|target range = {{dv|{{tt|550|Initial cast dash range}}|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|765|Recast dash range}}}}<!--yes, really-->
|speed        = {{tt|600 + {{as|100% movement speed}}|Dash speed}}
<!--|width        = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|230|Center-to-edge, estimated}}-->
|cast time    = none
|targeting    = [[Direction-targeted|Direction]] / [[Auto-targeted|Auto]]
|affects      = Enemies
|spellshield  = True
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = True
|knockdown    = True
|notes        = 
* ''Jousting'' will go on cooldown at the end of its first dash, but its cooldown cannot be reduced by cooldown refunding effects such as {{ri|Transcendence}} while its mark is active.{{bug}}
* Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* Casting {{ai|Chaaaaaaaarge!!!|Kled}} during ''Jousting'' will not interrupt the dash.
* The mark is removed at 765 range center-to-edge, which allows '''Kled''' to attempt to cast ''Jousting'' while outside of maximum range.{{bug}}
** Attempting to recast ''Jousting'' while outside of maximum range will make '''Kled''' path 550 units in the direction of the mark and consume the mark without casting the ability.
* When recasting ''Jousting'', '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' will {{tip|Dash}} to the marked target's location at the time of recasting, then {{tip|Dash}} another {{tt|200|estimated}} units.
** The {{tt|200|estimated}} unit dash cannot pass through terrain.
** If the marked target's location at the time of recasting happens to be inside terrain, ''Jousting'' will end upon reaching terrain.
* The speed of the dashes is not updated dynamically during the dash.<!--not sure about the extra 200-350 dashes-->
* The first dash can pass through terrain if '''Kled''' is already inside that terrain.
* The first dash can enter terrain within a short radius.
** This allows '''Kled''' to sometimes pass through {{cai|Dark Procession|Yorick}} with the first cast of ''Jousting''.{{bug}}
** {{Pending for test}} the first dash's terrain forgiveness radius
* ''Jousting'' can be recast even while the marked target is {{tip|untargetable}} or {{tip|death|dead}}.
** If the marked target dies shortly after being marked, the mark will not be visible.{{bug}}
* ''Jousting'' cannot affect {{ci|Neeko}} disguised as a {{tip|ward}}.{{bug}}
* {{Pending for test}} ''Jousting's'' hitbox, minion pull direction, speed and range
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Kled''' is dashing:

|damage = true
|damagedetails=

|dtitle   = Kled - Jousting: Pass Through
|dtype    = p
|dability = true
|darea    = true
|dApplyDamageModifier = 
|dApplyLifesteal      = false
|dApplyOmnivamp       = true
|dEnableCallForHelp   = false
|dEnableKill          = 
|dRespectDodge        = false
|dRespectImmunity     = 
|dTriggerDamageEvents =

|dnotes = 
* Applies to all 4 dashes.
}}

}}

* ''Jousting'' will go on cooldown at the end of its first dash, but its cooldown cannot be reduced by cooldown refunding effects such as {{ri|Transcendence}} while its mark is active.{{bug}}
* Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* Casting {{ai|Chaaaaaaaarge!!!|Kled}} during ''Jousting'' will not interrupt the dash.
* The mark is removed at 765 range center-to-edge, which allows '''Kled''' to attempt to cast ''Jousting'' while outside of maximum range.{{bug}}
** Attempting to recast ''Jousting'' while outside of maximum range will make '''Kled''' path 550 units in the direction of the mark and consume the mark without casting the ability.
* When recasting ''Jousting'', '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' will {{tip|Dash}} to the marked target's location at the time of recasting, then {{tip|Dash}} another {{tt|200|estimated}} units.
** The {{tt|200|estimated}} unit dash cannot pass through terrain.
** If the marked target's location at the time of recasting happens to be inside terrain, ''Jousting'' will end upon reaching terrain.
* The speed of the dashes is not updated dynamically during the dash.<!--not sure about the extra 200-350 dashes-->

<!-- The following values are defined as parameters
-->{{#vardefine:RS1|20}}<!-- Rank 1 base shield
-->{{#vardefine:RS3|40}}<!-- Rank 3 base shield

-->{{#vardefine:RD3|8}}<!-- Rank 3 base damage
-->{{#vardefine:RDS|3}}<!-- Scaling damage AD ratio
-->{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Chaaaaaaaarge!!!|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Kled
|skill        = R
|icon         = Chaaaaaaaarge!!!.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kled''' & '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' become {{tip|ghosted}} and {{tip|Cc-immune|unstoppably}} charge to a location, building up {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and {{tip|shield}} and leaving a draft in their wake that grants ''Mr. Kled's Wild Ride'' to allies that follow the draft.
|blurb2       = '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to the first enemy champion encountered, {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}}, and dealing {{as|magic damage}} based on travel time.
|blurb4       = {{sbc|Mr. Kled's Wild Ride:}} Gain a large amount of {{sti|ms|{{as|movement speed|ms}}}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kled''' & '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' charge toward the target location, automatically navigating terrain along the way, during which they are {{tip|ghosted}}, {{tip|Cc-immune|immune to crowd control}} and {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} to enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} in a {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|1250|estimated}} radius. If the charge does not complete within 15 seconds, it will end prematurely. The charge is interrupted instantly if '''Kled''' ''{{ai|Dismounted Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard|Kled|dismounts}}'' during it.
|icon2        = Chaaaaaaaarge!!! 2.png
|description2 = While charging, the duo gain an initial {{tip|shield}}, plus an additional amount for every {{fd|0.25}} seconds of traveling, up to a cap at 2 seconds. The shield lasts for 2 seconds upon finishing the charge. Additionally, the duo trails a directional draft in their wake, lasting 9 seconds. Allied units other than lane {{tip|minions}} following the draft gain ''Mr. Kled's Wild Ride''. After {{fd|0.5}} seconds of charging, the duo gain {{tt|{{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds|see notes}}, up to {{tt|{{as|950 '''total''' movement speed|ms}}|after movement speed soft caps}} over 3 seconds.
|leveling2    = 
{{st|Total Shield|{{ap|{{#var:RS1}}*10 to {{#var:RS3}}*10}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:{{#var:RSS}}*10}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Initial Shield|{{ap|{{#var:RS1}}*2 to {{#var:RS3}}*2}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:{{#var:RSS}}*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Shield Per Instance|{{ap|{{#var:RS1}} to {{#var:RS3}}}} {{as|(+ {{#var:RSS}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|description3 = {{sbc|Mr. Kled's Wild Ride:}} While in [[combat status|champion combat]], gain {{sti|ms|{{as|40% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}. After not being in champion combat for 3 seconds, if '''Kled''' is charging, gain {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} up to {{as|'''Kled's current''' movement speed}}; otherwise gain up to {{tt|{{as|650 '''total''' movement speed|ms}}|after movement speed soft caps}}.
|description4 = '''Kled''' & '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' will {{tip|dash}} toward the first {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champion {{tt|in range of the charge|see notes}}, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} the target during the dash and colliding with the first visible enemy champion in their path to deal {{as|magic damage}}, increased by {{pp|type=charge time|key=%|label=Damage Increase|0 to 200 for 26|0 to 4|formula=8% increase per 0.16 seconds. ''This is capped at 4 seconds of time active.''}}, {{tip|airborne|knock them back}} 150 units, though {{tt|not through terrain|see notes}}, and end the charge.
|leveling4    = {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|{{#var:RD1}} to {{#var:RD3}}}}% {{as|(+ {{#var:RDS}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|{{#var:RD1}}*3 to {{#var:RD3}}*3}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:RDS}}*3}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
|target range = {{tt|500 - ({{ap|3500 to 4500}})|Minimum and maximum target range (max range scales with rank)}}
|speed        = {{dv|{{tt|1000|Dash speed}}|{{tt|600|Collision knock back speed}}}}
|cast time    = none
|cooldown     = {{ap|140 to 110}} 
|cdstart      = on-cast
|customlabel2 = search range
|custominfo2  = {{dv|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|500|For enemy champions, see notes}}|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|800|For visible enemy champions, see notes}}}}<!--I don't care if it says 700 in data--><!--the visual also scales with kled's size-->
|targeting    = location
|affects      = Self, Enemies, Allies
|spellshield  = True
|outofrange   = walk to location
|grounded     = True
|knockdown    = special
|flavorsound  = {{sm2|Kled Original R SFX 0.ogg}} ''Charge alert.''
|notes        = 
'''The Charge'''
* While charging, if any out of {{tip|sight}} enemy {{tip|champions}} were within {{tt|500|estimated}} range of '''Kled''' during the last {{tt|second|estimated}}, '''Kled''' locks on to the closest visible enemy champion within {{tt|800|estimated}} range in his facing direction, and begins dashing toward them.
* During the charge the duo gain (950{{minus}}({{tt|'''starting''' movement speed|movement speed at the beginning of the charge; after movement speed soft caps}})){{divided by}}12{{times}}(time{{divided by}}{{fd|0.25}}) {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}
** The bonus movement speed is not affected by [[movement speed|movement speed caps]].
** The charge will not give any movement speed to the duo if they have more than {{ft|1440 raw movement speed|950 after movement speed soft caps}}.
* The trail will not give '''Kled''' and his allies any movement speed out-of-champion-combat if they have more than {{ft|840 raw movement speed|650 after movement speed soft caps}}.
* Movement speed is granted by facing the direction of the draft and lasts for {{rutngt|0.5}} upon exiting the trail or facing another direction.
* {{ui|Voidmite|Voidmites}}, and {{cis|Bel'Veth}} [[File:Bel'Veth Death in Lavender.png|20px|border]] [[Bel'Veth#Pets|Void Remora]] are considered to be lane {{tip|minions}} for the purpose of ''Mr. Kled's Wild Ride''.
* '''Kled''' will re-path if his current path is blocked by a newly created terrain (either player created or by the {{ui|Mountain Drake|Mountainous Rift}}).
* The charge will continue towards the target location even if '''Kled's''' location changes drastically.
* '''Kled''' will mark his path with an indicator visible to him and his allies.
** '''Kled's''' pathing indicator will not account for changes in '''Kled's''' pathing.<!--
-->{{safesubst:unexpected|desc=
*** '''Kled's''' pathing indicator will sometimes display a path different from his real path.{{bug}} [https://www.twitch.tv/lec/clip/FastSpinelessHorseHassanChop-_MVKuCgGNtfOEOSJ]|affectedEffects=Kled R|estimatedPatchOrigin=V6.16|<!--added automatically-->wikiUploadTimestamp=1774029734|<!--added automatically-->pagename=Template:Data Kled/Chaaaaaaaarge!!!
}}
* '''Kled's''' {{tip|shield}} generation is based upon a global {{fd|0.25}} second timer, not based on when the ability is cast or when it ends.{{bug|2}}
** For example, this means that '''Kled''' will take an additional {{fd|0.25}} seconds to generate the maximum shield amount if the ability was cast immediately after the last tick of the global timer.
** For example, this means that '''Kled's''' shield will expire {{fd|0.25}} seconds sooner if his charge ends immediately before the next tick of the global timer.
* {{ri|Axiom Arcanist}} only increases the {{tt|first instance|the initial shield consists of 2 instances}} of shield gained.{{bug}}
'''The Dash'''
* If '''Kled''' passes over the charge's target location, the charge will end even during the dash.{{bug}}
* If the charge ends before, or during the dash, the dash will not:
** Generate a shield;
** Trail a directional draft, applying ''Mr. Kled's Wild Ride'';
** Disable summoner spells and items.
{{safesubst:unexpected|desc=
* '''Kled''' sometimes fails to lock on to valid targets in range.{{bug}} [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FrraCGAey3o]|affectedEffects=Kled R|estimatedPatchOrigin=V6.16|<!--added automatically-->wikiUploadTimestamp=1774029734|<!--added automatically-->pagename=Template:Data Kled/Chaaaaaaaarge!!!
}}
* {{iis|Experimental Hexplate}} {{nie|Overdrive}}, {{iis|Fiendhunter Bolts}} {{nie|Opening Barrage}}, and {{iis|Zeke's Convergence}} {{nie|Frostfire Tempest}} trigger at the end of the charge or at the end of the dash, whichever comes last, even if the charge ends before or during the dash.
* '''Kled''' and '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' will track the target if they change locations.
** They will dash to the target's previous location if the target moves beyond {{tt|2500|Estimated}} units of the dash's beginning location.
** If the target moves {{tt|2500|Estimated}} or more units away from '''Kled''' and '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' during the dash, it will be interrupted.
** If the dash does not complete within 9 seconds, '''Kled''' and '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' will continue to track their target, but will be able to cast spells, and will not be able to collide with enemy champions.
* While dashing, '''Kled''' will mark his target with an indicator visible to both teams.
* The damage dealt is based on time spent traveling before the beginning of the dash.
{{safesubst:unexpected|desc=
* It is possible for '''Kled''' to briefly lose his {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} while colliding with an enemy champion, which can allow the {{tip|dash}}, and its subsequent damage and {{tip|airborne|displacement}} to get {{tip|knockdown|interrupted}}.{{bug}} [https://www.twitch.tv/soulmario/clip/GracefulKathishLEDNotATK-z8lcRukK7sQrI1jS]|affectedEffects=Kled R; Self CC-Immune|estimatedPatchOrigin=V6.16|<!--added automatically-->wikiUploadTimestamp=1774029734|<!--added automatically-->pagename=Template:Data Kled/Chaaaaaaaarge!!!
}}
* Units knocked back by ''Chaaaaaaaarge!!!'' {{tip|airborne|knockback}} can pass through terrain if it is [[Terrain#Player-Generated|player-generated]], or if they are already inside it.{{bug|2}}
* The {{tip|airborne}} debuff is removed early when the forced movement stops.
'''Buffering Interactions'''
* Nothing can be buffered during the charge.
* Movement and attack commands, as well as {{ai|Bear Trap on a Rope|Kled}} and {{ai|Jousting|Kled}} can be buffered during the dash.
'''Interaction Tables'''
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Kled''' is charging:
** {{si|Ghost}} is also disabled, {{tt|contrary to the table below|technical limitation (hopefully temporary)}}.
{{ct|attack=false|move=	Allowed, but cannot input movement commands.|cast=false|items=false|consume=false|spells=true, false, false, false, false, false, false|interrupts=false}}
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Kled''' is dashing:
{{ct|attack=false|move=false|cast=false|items=false|consume=false|spells=false|interrupts=false}}
* Every summoner spell is disabled, but summoner spells that aren't disabled while '''Kled''' is charging will not visually appear disabled.{{bug}}
* No summoner spells or items are disabled if the charge ends before or during the dash.{{bug}}
|tips        =
* Since {{as|movement speed}} lost from {{tip|slows}} is not regained when they expire while '''Kled''' is charging, it's advised for players to wait for short duration slows and similar debuffs (eg. {{cai|Shield of Durand|Galio}}) to expire before casting ''Chaaaaaaaarge!!!''.
* If unsure which path '''Kled''' will take while charging, players can order him to move to the desired location and see his path on the minimap.
* '''Kled''' would need to start charging with less than {{as|-250 '''total''' movement speed}} in order to accelerate faster than {{cai|Unstoppable Onslaught|Sion}}.

* Nothing can be buffered during the charge.
* Movement and attack commands, as well as {{ai|Bear Trap on a Rope|Kled}} and {{ai|Jousting|Kled}} can be buffered during the dash.

* Since {{as|movement speed}} lost from {{tip|slows}} is not regained when they expire while '''Kled''' is charging, it's advised for players to wait for short duration slows and similar debuffs (eg. {{cai|Shield of Durand|Galio}}) to expire before casting ''Chaaaaaaaarge!!!''.
* If unsure which path '''Kled''' will take while charging, players can order him to move to the desired location and see his path on the minimap.
* '''Kled''' would need to start charging with less than {{as|-250 '''total''' movement speed}} in order to accelerate faster than {{cai|Unstoppable Onslaught|Sion}}.
